name: AI Usage
description: Unified multi-account AI usage app for Codex, Grok, Claude, Antigravity, Cursor, Kimi Code, GitHub Copilot, Z.ai, MiniMax, WorkBuddy, and DeepSeek, with configurable Home Screen widgets and an optional persistent Home Tab for Scripting Pro users.
